title: Weil form operators: papers, Lean verification and numerical experiments
description:
Four draft articles on completed arithmetic operators, the Weil quadratic form, causal response and finite spectral selection, with a Lean 4 verification snapshot and twelve numerical experiments.

  1. An operator-theoretic representation of the Weil quadratic form
  2. θ correlations and a causal range criterion for the Weil form
  3. Arithmetic reconstruction and endpoint regularity of the completed ζ response
  4. Constant-mode transfer and compactness criteria for finite Weil characteristics
